description: This file defines the EventHubPartitionGeneratorReceiver class, which implements the IEventHubReceiver interface to provide event data reception for a streaming system, configured with a data generator, and includes methods for controlling data generation and cleanup.

classes.name: EventHubPartitionGeneratorReceiver
classes.description: Implements IEventHubReceiver to provide event data reception from a data generator, with control methods for stream data generation and cleanup.

methods.name: EventHubPartitionGeneratorReceiver
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the receiver with a data generator.

methods.name: ReceiveAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously receives event data, either from the generator or after waiting.

methods.name: StopProducingOnStream
methods.description: Stops data production for a given stream if the generator supports it.

methods.name: ConfigureDataGeneratorForStream
methods.description: Configures the data generator for a specific stream.

methods.name: CloseAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously closes the receiver; currently a no-op.
